explanation: The uprising’s article is one sentence and it is the whole argument: it “was an attempt by Alexander Kerensky to crush the October Revolution and regain power after the Bolsheviks overthrew his government in Petrograd”, between 8 and 13 November 1917 [O.S. 26 and 31 October]. The record carries the Julian dates the item gives and says so in `when.calendar`, which is what keeps this edge on the right side of the arrow of time.
